integrity: All finite experiments are subordinate to an explicit infinite carry-matrix proof; the polynomial recurrence is symbolic and no claim of independent certification is made.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the four-ary Fuss–Catalan sequence at the prime two and index blocks anchored at zero.
The normal limit concerns uniform sampling inside dyadic blocks.
The literature comparison was bounded and an unlocated stronger general digit-transducer or valuation theorem could imply the formula.
Independent proof review has not been performed.
title: Exact dyadic valuation census and sharp extremal layers for quaternary Fuss–Catalan numbers
